title: Microsoft 365 degradation leaves some email down for hours
summary: On Nov. 12, Microsoft 365 users reported a service degradation that left email unavailable for hours for some organizations. Status updates relayed in the discussion said Microsoft had validated an alternative health check on a subset of affected infrastructure and was applying it more broadly; a later 10 p.m. ET update said the change was not taking as expected. Commenters reported email down for 5.5 to 8 hours—including one organization with more than 15,000 employees—while Teams chat and meetings and Azure infrastructure appeared unaffected.
